items.summary: Recommendation: maintain spend and monetization containment. Do not admit new implementation, marketing, infrastructure, or affiliate expansion while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; all commission is in aggregate tracking ID "other", so site revenue is $0 attributed and revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts are unsupported. AI usage on 2026-10-01 is $2.2785467 across 16 calls, or approximately $0.142409 per call, across only 4 instrumented sites; cost-to-learn is not calculable because spend is not linked to incremental or proven outcomes and the cost and revenue windows do not align. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after capacity and overlap clearance, with no lift or revenue claim.
